outcome: HALT, route closed: the Gemini CLI Google-account route is refused by the Code Assist backend before any model request (IneligibleTierError, reasonCode UNSUPPORTED_CLIENT, tierId free-tier, tierName 'Gemini Code Assist for individuals'). The refusal comes from the account tier and client (server side); isolation itself held up to the tier check. ADR-019 item 4 as amended (2026-10-08, commit 1185a1f, the parent of this probe commit) already records this refusal and binds the route to the Antigravity CLI (agy 1.1.23, dedicated home <HOME>/.firewall/labeller-agy-home, model gemini-3.1-pro-high). This route is not resumed; the next step is the agy isolation probe under that amendment, not a new author decision.

isolation.configHome: GEMINI_CLI_HOME=<HOME>/.firewall/labeller-gemini/home (also HOME, so os.homedir() lookups stay inside it); env -i with an allow-list
isolation.credentialReuse: supported without copying: fetchCachedCredentials() tries <GEMINI_CLI_HOME>/.gemini/oauth_creds.json, then the path in GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS; the child gets GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=<HOME>/.gemini/oauth_creds.json and GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_GCA=true. The CLI reads the file; the probe never read, copied or edited it (size and mtime unchanged before/after). DO NOT REPEAT: pointing the child at the author's ambient <HOME>/.gemini/oauth_creds.json tied the dedicated home to the ambient ~/.gemini, against the spirit of ADR-019 item 4, and carries the refresh hazard below. Any CLI route signs in inside its own dedicated home (as the agy amendment does: Google OAuth into <HOME>/.firewall/labeller-agy-home) and never references ~/.gemini credentials.
isolation.credentialRefreshHazard: on a token refresh the CLI writes the refreshed tokens (no refresh_token) to <GEMINI_CLI_HOME>/.gemini/oauth_creds.json, which is tried first on the next call; a provider would have to remove that file (names only) before each call. Not observed in this probe (no refresh happened).

isolation.contextFiles: neutral mktemp cwd; context.fileName = DAEDALUS-NO-CONTEXT.md; includeDirectoryTree false; user-level GEMINI.md lives under GEMINI_CLI_HOME (empty); advanced.ignoreLocalEnv true

isolation.authSource: oauth-personal (Login with Google) via GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_GCA=true and security.auth.selectedType; GEMINI_API_KEY must stay out of the child env (it would select API-key auth)
isolation.autoUpdate: general.enableAutoUpdate false and enableAutoUpdateNotification false in the system settings; pin by checking gemini --version == 0.46.0
